content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 ClickGUARD Inc.: RevOps Manager Anywhere in the World Virginia Data Analysis, HubSpot, Revenue Management, Sales, and Workflow Description Language Sales and Marketing Contract <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0074/4123/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.clickguard.com/">https://www.clickguard.com/</a> </p> <p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>We are seeking a hands-on, systems-driven RevOps Manager to own the data, tools, and processes behind every stage of our revenue funnel: signup, trial, paid, renewal, expansion, and churn. ClickGuard will run four motions on the same stack: a self-serve trial, a sales-assisted motion for larger advertisers, outbound to advertisers and PPC agencies, and an agency partner program. This role makes sure a trial, a paying customer, and a dollar of MRR are counted the same way in HubSpot, Stripe, PostHog, and every report built on them. This is an AI-first operations role for someone who has personally built revenue systems that leadership used to run the business, and who uses AI to do the work of a larger ops team. You will own our CRM, our funnel data, the weekly revenue scorecard, and the workflows that move accounts from one stage to the next.</span></p> <p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>Your superpower is turning messy, disconnected data into numbers people act on. You treat RevOps as a data and systems problem first, and an admin problem second. Every workflow you build has an owner, a test, and an alert when it breaks, so a broken lead flow shows up in your inbox the same day it breaks and gets fixed before it reaches the quarter-end numbers.</span></p> <p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>Using AI tools is the baseline. We want someone who can show what they have personally built with AI, how it changed their workflow or capacity, and what measurable impact it had on data quality, speed, conversion, revenue, or headcount efficiency.</span></p> <p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><strong><span>What You'll Own</span></strong></p> <ul> <li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>HubSpot end-to-end: object model (contacts, companies, workspaces, deals, tickets), lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, workflows, and permissions, with one owner per field and every critical workflow tested and monitored</span></li> <li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>The revenue data layer (built with our engineering and data team): the app, Stripe, and HubSpot feeding PostHog, with shared definitions for trial, paid, MRR, churn, expansion, and reactivation that every report uses</span></li> <li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>Funnel instrumentation and attribution: source captured at signup, account qualification by measured ad spend, and a clear trail from first touch to trial to paid to renewal</span></li> <li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>AI-powered RevOps systems at scale: build and operate workflows where AI materially increases throughput across enrichment, routing, lead and account scoring, health scoring, data hygiene, and reporting. You should be able to demonstrate systems you have personally built and the business results they produced.</span></li> <li> <p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>The weekly revenue scorecard for the leadership meeting, pulled from source data; and the operating processes behind sales and customer success: quote and discount approvals, agency account handovers, refunds, chargebacks, and failed-payment recovery.</span></p> </li> </ul> <p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><strong><span>You're a Fit If</span></strong></p> <ul> <li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>You've personally rebuilt a CRM</span><span> that a revenue team relied on, and you can show the before and after: workflows fixed, fields retired, duplicate records merged, and reports leadership started to trust.</span></li> <li><span>You have built real AI-powered workflows</span><span> and can show what you built, where AI sat in the workflow, what it automated or augmented, and the measurable impact it created.</span></li> <li><span>You understand subscription revenue</span><span> well enough to reconcile MRR between Stripe and the CRM, and to explain why the two numbers differ</span></li> <li class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>Hands-on with HubSpot (Operations Hub or equivalent), SQL, CLI, API’s, scoring and routing</span></li> </ul> <p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><strong><span>You're Not a Fit If</span></strong></p> <ul> <li class="MuiTypography-root-175 role is the builder for our foundation</span></li> </ul> <p class="MuiTypography-root-175 MuiTypography-body1-177"><span>Required Skills &amp; Experience</span></p> <ul> <li><strong><span>3-5+ Years in RevOps or Revenue Systems: </span></strong><span>Proven experience owning the CRM and revenue data for a B2B SaaS company, ideally one with a self-serve trial or product-led motion. You can show the numbers: data completeness, workflow reliability, funnel conversion, forecast accuracy, and time saved.</span></li> <li><strong><span>CRM Architecture: </span></strong><span>Concrete experience designing an object model, lifecycle stages, and pipelines from scratch, or rebuilding a broken one, including migrations that keep the history intact. You document every field you create and retire the ones nobody uses.</span></li> <li><strong><span>Data Ownership: </span></strong><span>You have personally owned the path from source system to report: event tracking, warehouse tables, SQL, and reconciliation against billing.
